items.q: When and How Do I Get Access?
items.a: The moment you buy, you are taken to your Course dashboard with everything inside. A confirmation email with your links also arrives within 5 to 10 minutes. If you do not see it, check spam or the promotions tab. Log in with the email you bought with.

items.q: Do I Need to Know Excel?
items.a: Not at all! If you can enter numbers in a box and pick from a dropdown menu, you can use this tool effortlessly. You type in the highlighted cells, and the template handles all 456+ formulas automatically.

items.q: Does It Work on Google Sheets and on Mac?
items.a: Yes! The master files are 100% compatible with Microsoft Excel (Windows & macOS) as well as Google Sheets on any desktop, tablet, or smartphone.

items.q: What Is the Difference Between the Two Plans?
items.a: The Template Only plan gives you instant access to the core Initial Estimate template and tutorial. The Complete Bundle includes all 3 templates (Initial Estimate, Master Rate Sheet, GST Invoice) plus full video masterclass training and all bonuses.

items.q: Is This a One Time Payment?
items.a: Yes, it is a single one-time payment. You get lifetime access to the course and all templates, including every future update completely free.
Yes! We offer a 100% risk-free money-back guarantee. If you use the template and don't feel it saves you hours of time or helps you close clients faster, simply reach out to us for a prompt refund.

items.q: How Is This Different from a Free Template Online?
items.a: Free online templates are generic spreadsheets with broken formulas and no Indian interior design standards. Our system is built specifically for Indian interior designers and architects, preloaded with real room types, material grades (A1–A4), auto-calculating fees, GST, and client-ready branded PDF export.
Our student support team is always available via email at support@eazydezyn.com to assist you with any questions or template customizations.
